My name is on this land and I have been farming rice here for many years. This rice plot of mine is not too big, but rice is hungry for fertilizer and the soil is tired, so I must buy some urea and NPK from the market even though prices are high this year. I will use improved seed because the extension people brought a better variety that gives more grain, and I will spray small herbicide because weeding rice by hand alone is too much work for my family. I depend on the rain and the swampy lowland for water — I have no pump — and during transplanting and harvest I will hire a few young men from the village to help my wife and children.
